policy: Evidence is model-specific and scope-limited. A deterministic software snapshot is never independent source reproduction. Source-equation checks do not prove external clinical predictive performance.

entries.sourceLocation: Roberts et al. (2011), final population model equations (3)-(4), Table 2
entries.population: 206 critically ill adults receiving vancomycin by continuous infusion
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment zero-order input: CL=4.58*(CRCL/100), V=1.53*WT, C(t)=rate/CL*(1-exp(-CL*t/V)), 0<t<=infusion duration.
verifiedScope: population concentrations for a single continuous infusion

entries.sourceLocation: Revilla et al. (2010), final covariate model; Table 4
entries.population: Adult ICU patients treated with intravenous vancomycin
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment IV bolus: CL=(0.67*(CRCL/WT)+AGE^(-0.24))*WT*0.06, V=0.82*2.49^(CREAT_umolL/88.4>1)*WT, C(t)=dose/V*exp(-CL*t/V).
scenarios: higher renal clearance and older age
verifiedScope: conversion of kg-normalized mL/min clearance to L/h
population concentrations following an IV bolus

entries.sourceLocation: Goti et al. (2018), final fixed-effect 2-compartment model; parameter equations independently corroborated in Antibiotics 2023;12:301, Table 2, doi:10.3390/antibiotics12020301
entries.population: Hospitalized adults with and without intermittent hemodialysis
entries.mathematicalOracle: Two-compartment independent analytical IV bolus biexponential: k10=CL/V1; k12=Q/V1; k21=Q/V2; alpha,beta are roots of the disposition characteristic polynomial; C(t)=D/V1*((alpha-k21)/(alpha-beta)*exp(-alpha*t)+(k21-beta)/(alpha-beta)*exp(-beta*t)). Published CL and V1 renal, weight and dialysis equations are independently evaluated. Only within-domain CRCL<150 mL/min and no low-creatinine elderly floor conditions are tested.
scenarios: male 50 years, weight 70 kg, creatinine 80 umol/L, without hemodialysis
female 55 years, weight 85 kg, creatinine 125 umol/L, with hemodialysis
older male 70 years, weight 75 kg, creatinine 110 umol/L, without hemodialysis
verifiedScope: published typical CL, V1, V2 and Q with dialysis-status effects in tested domain
Cockcroft-Gault sex/weight/age/creatinine units within tested range
independently calculated two-compartment bolus IV concentration-time solution
exclusions: renal CRCL 150 mL/min upper cap and serum creatinine 1 mg/dL floor for selected elderly patients: documented discrepancy against published secondary reproduction; primary-source confirmation and code reconciliation pending
